note: Sepsis/septicemia is never named; only 'concurrent bacteremia' qualifies pneumonia/UTI cases, which is not sepsis.

quote: indicated in the treatment of chronic lymphatic (lymphocytic) leukemia
note: Only CLL is indicated; 'leukemia' as a whole disease class (incl. acute leukemias) is overbroad.

quote: excessive sleepiness associated with obstructive sleep apnea (OSA), narcolepsy, or shift work disorder (SWD)
note: Managing narcolepsy's cardinal manifestation counts as disease management, analogous to the rubric's osteoarthritis-pain example.

quote: Short- term treatment of active duodenal ulcer
note: Label covers peptic (duodenal/gastric) ulcers; generic 'Ulceration' of any organ/tissue is a much broader category.

quote: temporarily relieves nasal congestion due to the common cold, hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies
note: Text relieves a symptom (nasal congestion) only; edge names the underlying disorders, matching the rubric's canonical FP2 example.

quote: associated with significant loss of bone mineral density (BMD)
note: Low bone density (osteopenia) appears only as a warning; the sole bone indication (prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis) is a different condition on an estrogen-plus-progestin combo label.

quote: indicated for treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE)
note: HAE attacks are angioedema episodes; angioedema is a near parent condition, not a whole disease class or organ-system category.

quote: Prophylaxis and treatment of thromboembolic complications associated with atrial fibrillation
note: The treated target is thromboembolism/embolization; atrial fibrillation is the background condition.

quote: indicated for the prophylaxis of common migraine headache
note: Only migraine prophylaxis is indicated; generic 'Headache' spans many headache disorders and is overbroad.

quote: for induction of intraoperative hypotension
note: Hypotension in the indication is a deliberately induced surgical effect, not a disorder treated; elsewhere it is only an adverse effect.

quote: with malignant and non-malignant diseases
note: The edge is the root term 'disease'; the indication is HSCT conditioning, so the claim is overbroad to the point of meaninglessness.

quote: prevention of serious lower respiratory tract disease caused by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV)
note: Indication is restricted to RSV disease; the organ-system category edge implies general LRT disorders.

quote: in the treatment or prevention of various types of euthyroid goiters, including thyroid nodules, subacute or chronic lymphocytic thyroiditis
note: Older labels list subacute thyroiditis under TSH-suppression indications; the 'not indicated' text concerns only recovery-phase hypothyroidism, and texts are a union.

quote: anorexia associated with weight loss in patients with Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome (AIDS)
note: Weight loss is part of the treated condition (anorexia with weight loss), not the background population (that is AIDS).

quote: Azithromycin is not recommended in patients with pneumonia who are judged to be inappropriate for oral therapy
note: Functional asplenia appears only in Limitations of Use as a risk factor where use is not recommended.
Supplied text is the cyclophosphamide label; it says nothing about the metabolite 4-hydroxycyclophosphamide as a product.

quote: Idiopathic bronchiolitis obliterans with organizing pneumonia
note: Only idiopathic BOOP is indicated; generic 'bronchiolitis' (e.g. infant viral bronchiolitis) is a broader grouping the label does not support.

quote: to reduce risk of stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
note: Heart conditions (AF, CAD, congenital heart disease) appear only as populations; the treated targets are thromboembolic events.

quote: relapsed or refractory mantle cell lymphoma (MCL)
note: Only R/R MCL and CLL/SLL are indicated; 'lymphoma' as a whole disease class is overbroad.

quote: Severe erythema multiforme (Stevens-Johnson syndrome)
note: Text treats named diseases (erythema multiforme, exfoliative erythroderma); edge names the generic skin sign erythema.

quote: reduce the risk of myocardial infarction
note: Label covers myocardial infarction only; generic 'Infarction' of any organ is an overbroad pathologic category.

quote: treatment of partial seizures, with or without secondary generalisation
note: Indication treats clinical partial seizures; the edge is an EEG finding (manifestation), not the treated condition or a synonym.

quote: Reduce the risk of hospitalization for congestive heart failure (CHF)
note: Heart failure risk reduction is atorvastatin's indication on the amlodipine/atorvastatin label; amlodipine's own text mentions heart failure only as a population exclusion.
